Ring Master - Non-Booking Lead Prioritization

Jun 9-17, 2026  ·  Leads where conversation happened but no appointment booked  ·  753 records with checklist data

Scope: These are leads from Jun 9-17 where a conversation happened but no appointment was booked (FOLLOWUP_REQUIRED, CALL_LATER, NOT_INTERESTED_AFTER_PITCH, LOW_VALUE_TAKEOVER, OFFER_REQUESTED), AND the caller filled the 10-field checklist in comments. Total non-booking conversations in this period: ~3,517. Records with checklist data: 753 (21%). The remaining 79% had no structured data in comments and are not included.
How leads are tagged
Re-attempt
Caller captured a genuine urgent need in the loan purpose field: medical, emergency, education, marriage, business requirement, construction, or land purchase. These customers have a real reason to take a loan now. Worth a second call even if they said no or need follow-up.
Defer
Customer is shopping for better rate, higher LTV, or max value. Includes: Low ROI / rate arbitrage requests, High LTV / extra amount / max value requests, Low Value Takeover dispositions (system-tagged), and customers with an existing GL but no stated purpose (assumed rate shopping). These will not convert at current gold rates.
Dead
Disposition is NOT_INTERESTED_AFTER_PITCH with no stated reason (blank or NA across all checklist fields). Customer heard the pitch and said no. No signal to act on. Low value re-attempting without a changed offer.
Not Serviceable
Serviceability Status field says No, or customer is outside coverage area / abroad. Drop from re-attempt queue.
Unclear
Checklist was filled but all key fields (purpose, loan requirement, outstanding) are blank or NA, and no GL status to infer from. Cannot determine intent. Needs manual review or a follow-up call with better qualification.
